author: flyofff
body:
Hey,
I've been thinking on this idea for months, and decided to make a forum post about it.

What's the Idea?
 My idea is making a platform that we can chat on website. Just like Facebook. You can check news while messaging with others (with this thing, players will be able to message with each others while checking new forum posts, or alerts etc.) I believe that many of you will like this idea but  please tell me your ideas! :)
